project_info.theme: Japanese-language argument for thoughtful AI adoption
project_info.color_palette: Navy, white, cyan, mint, coral orange, black, red accent

main_subject.detail: A dense Japanese vertical infographic uses stacked claim cards, angry-comment speech bubbles, a computer-to-laptop and feature-phone-to-smartphone comparison flow, practical AI-use icons, and a concluding question.
main_subject.style: Clear high-contrast editorial logic diagram with rounded white cards, bold Japanese typography, simple outline icons, and soft multicolor gradient bands

composition_elements.type: Structured text blocks, icons, arrows, and speech bubbles
composition_elements.text: 「AI＝悪者」だと思ってる人、まだ置いて行かれますよ。〜日本の将来を憂う声と、AIの本質的な価値〜; 問題の本質：AIが悪いのではなく、『AIの使い方』が良くない状況を是正しただけ; 冷静になって考えてみてください。歴史は繰り返す。; AIの活用はどんどん進化。ついていかなければ差がつく。; 私自身、AIなしの生活には戻れません。
items: Top: large black Japanese headline on pale cyan, then navy criticism banner with red angry-face icons and quote bubbles.
Upper Middle: white rounded card with crossed-out robot icon explaining the core issue.
Middle: two left-to-right comparison rows, vintage computer to laptop and feature phone to smartphone, connected by white arrows on cyan-to-mint gradient.
Lower Middle: orange gradient practical-AI section with notebook, magnifier, checklist, microphone, and brain icons.
Bottom: bold concluding question and three rounded action chips on pale blue.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean print-like contrast, crisp white cards, strong legibility, no realistic shadows beyond subtle UI depth

technical_specs.render_style: Vector infographic and editorial social graphic

assets.name: Japanese copy and information hierarchy
assets.source: source preview and approved Japanese copy deck
assets.usage: Preserve exact Japanese wording, line breaks, hierarchy, and arrow logic; generated text must be proofread by a native editor.

assets.name: technology and productivity icons
assets.usage: Keep a consistent outlined, friendly icon language.

assets.name: cyan-mint-coral band system
assets.usage: Retain the stacked color zones, rounded cards, and white connector arrows.

prompt_instructions: Attach a copy-approved Japanese layout reference; do not rely on image generation for final Japanese typesetting.
Preserve the argument sequence and contrast between hostile comments, historical comparisons, applications, and conclusion.
Use vector composition first, then place text with a professional layout tool.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Please create a clear diagram of the following text.
prompt.negative_prompt: garbled Japanese text, changed argument order, unclear arrows, illegible cards, clutter, photorealistic scene, low contrast, watermark, signature
